title: Qwen-Image-2.1 eager text-to-image on one 910B1: reuse plus interleaved RoPE, 30% not met
summary: The author reports: On one Ascend 910B1, conditioning reuse plus npu_rotary_mul interleaved RoPE cuts the eager BF16 1280×704 eight-step mean from 3111.5 ms to 2459.6 ms with identical RGBA. Opt-in VAE fastpath reaches 2425.5 ms and passes the quality gate without pixel identity. A 30% line at 2178 ms was not met.

conditions: BF16, eager, TORCH_SDPA, CFG=1, 1280×704, checkpoint native 8 sigmas
Two warmup rounds, then three repeated prompts with seeds 42/43/44
Unoptimized baseline mean 3111.5 ms; 30% line is 2178 ms
QWEN21_NPU_ROPE defaults to fused; QWEN21_NPU_ROPE=eager restores the unflatten/stack path
QWEN21_VAE_FASTPATH, QWEN21_ATTN and QWEN21_CACHE_STEP_INPUTS stay off unless set

claims.description: Conditioning reuse only: mean 2654.3 ms, −14.7% vs 3111.5 ms, decoded RGBA identical. An earlier same-patch cohort on this host was 2658.2 ms (−14.6%).

Reuse plus npu_rotary_mul interleaved RoPE: mean 2459.6 ms, −21.0%, RGBA identical. Atlas A2 npu_apply_rotary_pos_emb has no interleave mode. The fp32 cos/sin table follows the current freqs object; decode slices a longer table to the target-token tail.

Reuse plus NPU RoPE plus QWEN21_VAE_FASTPATH=1: mean 2425.5 ms, −22.0%. Quality gate passed (SSIM≥0.99, PSNR≥35 dB) and pixels were not identical. A later rerun of the same stack was 2431.9 ms (−21.8%).
A timed first request on the RoPE plus VAE stack spent about 550 ms in prompt encode, 1.5 s in the eight-step denoise, and 190 ms in the VAE.

Rejected without changing steps, resolution, or the sampler: eager RoPE cos/sin cache 2657.2 ms; expanded SDPA mask cache 2667.5 ms; npu_fusion_attention precise=2 at 2655.2 ms and precise=0 at 2623.7 ms; decode-only fusion 2631.7 ms; TASK_QUEUE_ENABLE=1 at 2654.4 ms and =2 at 2661.1 ms; enforce_eager=0 at 2718.8 ms; dropping the prompt-cache autograd guard at 2474.7 ms.
Per-step mask/prompt tensor cache, and RoPE plus VAE fastpath plus fusion attention, failed with NPU out-of-memory during allocation or initialization.
The 2425.5 ms stack is not pixel-identical. Do not describe it as the B300 384.16→266.60 ms five-group HTTP PASS.

recommendations: Keep npu_rotary_mul interleaved RoPE as the NPU default for this complex-pair layout, with QWEN21_NPU_ROPE=eager as the fallback.
Treat QWEN21_VAE_FASTPATH as opt-in until a pixel-identical VAE path exists.
Do not enable npu_fusion_attention or per-step input caching on a 64 GiB 910B1 that is already near a 30 GiB allocator watermark.
Budget the next hypothesis on the eight-step denoise, which remains the largest timed piece.
validation_plan: Repeat the three-seed warm cohort on a quiet 910B1 before quoting a new mean.
Keep pixel identity and the SSIM/PSNR gate as separate columns.
Re-time prompt encode, denoise, and VAE on a warm cache hit before claiming another stage win.
limitations: Single 910B1 eager cohort. Not a four-card B300 HTTP result and not a 30% PASS.
Three measured requests after warmup. No production tail claim.
Later repeats were blocked when the allocator could not reserve a small extra block and the NPU runtime reported insufficient compute resources.
Ascend 910B1 evidence does not transfer to CUDA, ROCm, or other Ascend SKUs.

Imported from amy-why-3459's report; raw per-request timings, RGBA outputs and a frozen validator are not included. No NPU rerun was performed for this import; OmniRSI acceptance remains INCONCLUSIVE.
